snippet.title: Michael Jackson's Son Bigi "Blanket" Makes Rare Red Carpet Appearance | E! News
snippet.description:
Michael Jackson's son Bigi "Blanket" Jackson, 24, and Prince Jackson, 29, joined the late singer's brothers at the Germany premiere of the ‘Michael’ biopic. Both Bigi, 24, and Prince, 29, paid tribute to their dad—who died in 2009 at age 50—with their wardrobe, each wearing a dark suit jacket adorned with a gold crown decal. The siblings completed their blazers with red armbands, which Michael often symbolically wore to advocate for children's rights. Their 28-year-old sister Paris Jackson did not attend the event, having previously slammed ‘Michael’ as a "sugar-coated" version of her father's life. Fans around the world are once again showing the strength of the Michael Jackson legacy, as the film brings his story, spirit, and essence to life, with Jaafar portraying and embodying Michael in a truly phenomenal way that only he can.
